title: Double Signed In
description: Nothing stops a dispatcher from logging in on both a desktop and a phone at once. Prove SwiftCargo tracks each session as its own ticket rather than collapsing them into one.
successCondition: Log in as the same demo account (e.g. dispatcher@swiftcargo.test) twice in a row, capturing both Set-Cookie th_refresh values. Querying the refresh_tokens table via `npm run db:psql` for that user's id shows 2 distinct rows, each with its own token_hash and a null revoked_at — logging in a second time never revoked or reused the first session's row.
hints: Every successful login inserts a brand-new refresh_tokens row (apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts's issueSession) — nothing about login itself touches existing rows.
select id, revoked_at from refresh_tokens where user_id = '<user id>'; is enough to see both sessions side by side.
